decisions.reason: As in 24:5: a homer is taken as 220 litres (term sheet), the Korean default is metric, and Literal keeps the unit.

source.text: אִם־מִשְּׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֑הוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֖ יָקֽוּם׃

records.literal_gloss: If from [the] year of the Jubilee he consecrates his field, according to your valuation it will stand.

en.L: If he consecrates his field from the year of the Jubilee, it shall stand according to your valuation.
en.B: If the field is consecrated from the Year of Jubilee onward, the full valuation will stand.
en.R: If the field is given in the Year of Jubilee, the full price stays the same.

es.L: Si consagra su campo desde el año del Jubileo, quedará conforme a tu valoración.
es.B: Si el campo se consagra a partir del año del Jubileo, se mantendrá la valoración completa.
es.R: Si el campo se da en el año del Jubileo, el precio completo no cambia.

fr.L: S’il consacre son champ dès l’année du Jubilé, il sera maintenu selon ton estimation.
fr.B: Si le champ est consacré à partir de l’année du Jubilé, l’estimation entière sera maintenue.
fr.R: Si le champ est donné pendant l’année du Jubilé, le prix reste entier.

sw.L: Ikiwa atalitakasa shamba lake tangu mwaka wa Yubile, litasimama kulingana na makadirio yako.
sw.B: Ikiwa shamba litatakaswa kuanzia mwaka wa Yubile, thamani yote itasimama.
sw.R: Shamba likitolewa katika mwaka wa Yubile, bei yote inabaki ileile.

ko.L: 만일 그가 희년부터 자기 밭을 거룩하게 구별하여 바치면, 네가 매기는 값대로 정해질 것이다.
ko.B: 희년부터 그 밭을 바치면, 매긴 값을 다 받는다.
ko.R: 희년에 밭을 바치면, 정해진 값이 그대로 다 적용된다.

decisions.choice: from the year of the Jubilee: at the start of the fifty-year cycle
decisions.reason: The Jubilee was the fiftieth year, when family land went back to its owners (25:10-13). A field given right after it would stay with the sanctuary for the whole cycle, so the full value applies.

decisions.choice: full
decisions.reason: The point is that nothing is taken off (compare verse 18); Balanced and Readable add "full".

decisions.choice: "el año del Jubileo", "el Jubileo"
decisions.reason: The fiftieth year of release (25:10-13). Capitalised as the name of a fixed year, as the English Balanced and Readable "Year of Jubilee" and the other feasts ("la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura").

decisions.choice: "l'année du Jubilé", "le Jubilé"
decisions.reason: The fiftieth year of release (25:10-13). Capitalised as the name of a fixed year, as the English "Year of Jubilee"; in ordinary French "jubilé" is also an anniversary, and the capital marks the biblical year.

decisions.choice: "mwaka wa Yubile", "Yubile"
decisions.reason: The fiftieth year of release (25:10-13). Swahili keeps the name of the year, as the other languages do, and the chapter explains it where the English Readable does (verse 21).

source.text: וְאִם־אַחַ֣ר הַיֹּבֵל֮ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ֒ וְחִשַּׁב־ל֨וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֗סֶף עַל־פִּ֤י הַשָּׁנִים֙ הַנּ֣וֹתָרֹ֔ת עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנִגְרַ֖ע מֵֽעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And if after the Jubilee he consecrates his field, and will calculate for him the priest the silver according to the mouth of the years that remain until [the] year of the Jubilee, and it will be deducted from your valuation.

en.L: But if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall calculate the silver for him according to the years that remain until the year of the Jubilee, and it shall be deducted from your valuation.
en.B: But if the field is consecrated after the Jubilee, the priest will work out the price by the years left until the next Year of Jubilee, and the valuation will be reduced to match.
en.R: But the field may be given some years after the Year of Jubilee. Then the priest will figure out the price by counting the years left until the next Jubilee. The price will be less.

es.L: Pero si consagra su campo después del Jubileo, entonces el sacerdote le calculará la plata conforme a los años que queden hasta el año del Jubileo, y se rebajará de tu valoración.
es.B: Pero si el campo se consagra después del Jubileo, el sacerdote calculará el precio según los años que falten hasta el próximo año del Jubileo, y la valoración se reducirá en proporción.
es.R: Pero el campo puede darse algunos años después del año del Jubileo. Entonces el sacerdote calculará el precio contando los años que faltan hasta el próximo Jubileo. El precio será menor.

fr.L: Mais s’il consacre son champ après le Jubilé, alors le prêtre calculera pour lui l’argent selon les années qui restent jusqu’à l’année du Jubilé, et cela sera déduit de ton estimation.
fr.B: Mais si le champ est consacré après le Jubilé, le prêtre calculera le prix d’après les années qui restent jusqu’à la prochaine année du Jubilé, et l’estimation sera réduite d’autant.
fr.R: Mais le champ peut être donné quelques années après l’année du Jubilé. Alors le prêtre calculera le prix en comptant les années qui restent jusqu’au prochain Jubilé. Le prix sera moins élevé.

sw.L: Lakini ikiwa atalitakasa shamba lake baada ya Yubile, ndipo kuhani atamhesabia fedha kulingana na miaka iliyobaki hadi mwaka wa Yubile, nayo itapunguzwa katika makadirio yako.
sw.B: Lakini shamba likitakaswa baada ya Yubile, kuhani atahesabu bei kwa miaka iliyobaki hadi mwaka wa Yubile unaofuata, na thamani itapunguzwa kwa kadiri hiyo.
sw.R: Lakini shamba linaweza kutolewa miaka kadhaa baada ya mwaka wa Yubile. Hapo kuhani atahesabu bei kwa kuhesabu miaka iliyobaki hadi Yubile inayofuata. Bei itakuwa ndogo zaidi.

ko.L: 그러나 만일 그가 희년 뒤에 자기 밭을 거룩하게 구별하여 바치면, 제사장은 희년까지 남은 햇수에 따라 그를 위하여 은을 계산하고, 네가 매기는 값에서 그만큼을 덜어야 한다.
ko.B: 그러나 희년이 지난 뒤에 밭을 바치면, 제사장은 다음 희년까지 남은 햇수에 따라 값을 계산하고, 매긴 값에서 그만큼 줄여야 한다.
ko.R: 그러나 희년이 지나고 몇 해 뒤에 밭을 바칠 수도 있다. 그러면 제사장은 다음 희년까지 남은 햇수를 세어서 값을 계산할 것이다. 그러면 값이 그만큼 줄어든다.

decisions.choice: according to the years that remain: a price in proportion to the time
decisions.reason: The field returns to its family in the Jubilee (verse 21), so the sanctuary holds it only for the years left until then. The price is lowered in proportion, much as the price of land in a sale is set by the years to the Jubilee (25:15-16).

decisions.choice: the next
decisions.reason: The years are counted to the coming Jubilee; Balanced and Readable add "next".

source.text: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֤ל יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה הַמַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִשִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְקָ֥ם לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And if indeed he redeems the field, the one consecrating it, and he will add a fifth of [the] silver of your valuation to it, and it will stand to him.

en.L: And if the one who consecrated it does indeed redeem the field, then he shall add a fifth of the silver of your valuation to it, and it shall stand [as] his.
en.B: If the one who consecrated the field does redeem it, they must pay its value in silver and a fifth more, and it will remain theirs.
en.R: If the owner wants to buy the field back, they must pay the price plus one fifth more. Then the field will be theirs again.

es.L: Y si el que lo consagró de hecho rescata el campo, entonces añadirá la quinta parte de la plata de tu valoración, y quedará [como] suyo.
es.B: Si el que consagró el campo lo rescata, tendrá que pagar su valor en plata y una quinta parte más, y seguirá siendo suyo.
es.R: Si el dueño quiere volver a comprar el campo, tiene que pagar el precio y una quinta parte más. Entonces el campo volverá a ser suyo.

fr.L: Et si celui qui l’a consacré rachète vraiment le champ, alors il ajoutera le cinquième de l’argent de ton estimation, et il lui restera acquis.
fr.B: Si celui qui a consacré le champ le rachète, il devra payer sa valeur en argent et un cinquième en plus, et le champ restera à lui.
fr.R: Si le propriétaire veut racheter le champ, il doit payer le prix et un cinquième en plus. Alors le champ sera de nouveau à lui.

sw.L: Na ikiwa yule aliyelitakasa kweli atalikomboa shamba, ndipo ataongeza sehemu ya tano ya fedha ya makadirio yako juu yake, nalo litasimama [kuwa] lake.
sw.B: Ikiwa aliyelitakasa shamba atalikomboa, atalipa thamani yake kwa fedha na kuongeza sehemu ya tano, nalo litabaki kuwa lake.
sw.R: Mwenye shamba akitaka kulinunua tena, lazima alipe bei na kuongeza sehemu ya tano zaidi. Ndipo shamba litakuwa lake tena.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 그 밭을 거룩하게 구별하여 바친 자가 정말로 그것을 무르려면, 네가 매기는 값의 은에 오분의 일을 더해야 하고, 그러면 그것이 그의 것으로 정해질 것이다.
ko.B: 밭을 바친 사람이 그 밭을 무르려면, 매긴 값의 은에 오분의 일을 더 얹어서 내야 한다. 그러면 그 밭은 계속 그의 것이 된다.
ko.R: 주인이 그 밭을 다시 사고 싶으면, 정해진 값에 오분의 일을 더 내야 한다. 그러면 그 밭은 다시 그의 것이 된다.

decisions.choice: add a fifth: as for a house
decisions.reason: The rule of verse 15 applies to a field: the value plus a fifth.

decisions.choice: it will stand to him: it will be confirmed as his
decisions.reason: The verb "stand" means to be firm or settled; the field is his once more.

source.text: וְאִם־לֹ֤א יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְאִם־מָכַ֥ר אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל עֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: And if not he redeems the field, and if he has sold the field to another man, not it will be redeemed again.

en.L: But if he does not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
en.B: But if they do not redeem the field, or if the field has been sold to someone else, it can never again be redeemed.
en.R: But if the owner does not buy the field back, or if it has been sold to someone else, it can never be bought back.

es.L: Pero si no rescata el campo, o si ha vendido el campo a otro, ya no será rescatado.
es.B: Pero si no rescata el campo, o si el campo ha sido vendido a otra persona, ya nunca podrá ser rescatado.
es.R: Pero si el dueño no vuelve a comprar el campo, o si se ha vendido a otra persona, ya nunca se podrá volver a comprar.

fr.L: Mais s’il ne rachète pas le champ, ou s’il a vendu le champ à un autre, il ne sera plus racheté.
fr.B: Mais s’il ne rachète pas le champ, ou si le champ a été vendu à quelqu’un d’autre, il ne pourra plus jamais être racheté.
fr.R: Mais si le propriétaire ne rachète pas le champ, ou si le champ a été vendu à quelqu’un d’autre, il ne pourra jamais être racheté.

sw.L: Lakini ikiwa hatalikomboa shamba, au ikiwa amemuuzia mtu mwingine shamba hilo, halitakombolewa tena.
sw.B: Lakini asipolikomboa shamba, au ikiwa shamba limeuzwa kwa mtu mwingine, haliwezi kukombolewa tena kamwe.
sw.R: Lakini mwenye shamba asipolinunua tena, au likiwa limeuzwa kwa mtu mwingine, haliwezi kununuliwa tena kamwe.

ko.L: 그러나 만일 그가 그 밭을 무르지 않거나, 그 밭을 다른 사람에게 팔았으면, 그것은 다시는 물러지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 그가 그 밭을 무르지 않거나, 그 밭이 다른 사람에게 팔렸으면, 다시는 그것을 무를 수 없다.
ko.R: 그러나 주인이 그 밭을 다시 사지 않거나, 그 밭이 다른 사람에게 팔렸으면, 다시는 그 밭을 사들일 수 없다.

decisions.choice: he has sold: who sold the field is not certain
decisions.reason: "He has sold" may mean the owner, who sold to someone else a field he had already given to the LORD and so had no right to sell. It may also mean the priest or the sanctuary, which sold the use of the field to another. In either case the first owner loses the right to buy it back.

decisions.choice: someone else
decisions.reason: "Another man" means any other person; Balanced and Readable say "someone else".

decisions.choice: has been sold
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the passive so as not to decide who sold it (m1). Literal keeps "he has sold".

source.text: וְהָיָ֨ה הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה בְּצֵאת֣וֹ בַיֹּבֵ֗ל קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה כִּשְׂדֵ֣ה הַחֵ֑רֶם לַכֹּהֵ֖ן תִּהְיֶ֥ה אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, holy to Yahweh, like the field of the devoted thing; to the priest will be his possession.

en.L: And the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, like the field of the devoted thing; it shall be the priest's possession.
en.B: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, like a field that is devoted to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. It will belong to the priest as his own land.
en.R: In the Year of Jubilee, when land goes back to its owners, this field will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It will be like land that is given to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} forever. It will belong to the priest.

es.L: Y el campo, cuando salga en el Jubileo, será santo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como el campo dedicado por completo; será posesión del sacerdote.
es.B: Cuando el campo quede libre en el Jubileo, será santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, como un campo dedicado por completo a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Pertenecerá al sacerdote como tierra propia.
es.R: En el año del Jubileo, cuando las tierras vuelven a sus dueños, este campo será {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Será como una tierra dada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} para siempre. Pertenecerá al sacerdote.

fr.L: Et le champ, quand il sortira au Jubilé, sera saint {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, comme le champ voué sans retour ; il sera la possession du prêtre.
fr.B: Quand le champ sera libéré au Jubilé, il sera saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme un champ qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est voué sans retour. Il appartiendra au prêtre comme sa propre terre.
fr.R: Pendant l’année du Jubilé, quand les terres reviennent à leurs propriétaires, ce champ appartiendra {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il sera comme une terre donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour toujours. Il appartiendra au prêtre.

sw.L: Na shamba hilo, litakapotoka katika Yubile, litakuwa takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama shamba lililowekwa wakfu kabisa; litakuwa milki ya kuhani.
sw.B: Shamba litakapoachiliwa katika Yubile, litakuwa takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama shamba lililowekwa wakfu kabisa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Litakuwa mali ya kuhani kama ardhi yake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa Yubile, ardhi inaporudishwa kwa wenyewe, shamba hili litakuwa mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Litakuwa kama ardhi iliyotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} milele. Litakuwa mali ya kuhani.

ko.L: 그리고 그 밭은 희년에 풀려날 때에, 온전히 바친 밭처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것이 될 것이다. 그것은 제사장의 소유가 될 것이다.
ko.B: 희년이 되어 그 밭이 풀려날 때에, 그 밭은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 온전히 바친 밭처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것이 된다. 그 밭은 제사장의 소유가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 희년에는 땅이 원래 주인에게 돌아가지만, 이 밭은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이 된다. 그 밭은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 영원히 바친 땅과 같다. 그 밭은 제사장의 것이 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: when it goes out in the Jubilee: when land is released
decisions.reason: In the Jubilee land "goes out" from the one who bought it and returns to its family (25:28, 31). This field does not go back to its first owner but passes for good to the LORD.

decisions.choice: the devoted thing: something given over to the LORD for good
decisions.reason: This is the first use in Leviticus of the word explained at verse 28: something devoted wholly and finally to the LORD. A devoted field becomes the priests' (Numbers 18:14; Ezekiel 44:29).

decisions.choice: to the priest: the priesthood holds it
decisions.reason: "The priest" most likely means the priests as a body, who hold the field as a possession in place of the family that gave it up.

decisions.choice: when land goes back to its owners
decisions.reason: Readable explains what "goes out in the Jubilee" means (m1).

decisions.choice: "dedicado por completo" for the devoted thing (here and verse 28)
decisions.reason: "Consagrar" already renders the verb "consecrate" in this chapter (verses 14-22), so the devoted thing, which cannot be bought back (m2), needs a word of its own; "anatema" now sounds like a curse. Verse 29, where a person is devoted to destruction, says "consagrado a la destrucción", as Exodus 22.

decisions.choice: "voué sans retour" for the devoted thing (here and verse 28)
decisions.reason: "Consacrer" already renders the verb "consecrate" in this chapter (verses 14-22), so the devoted thing needs a word of its own; "sans retour" says what sets it apart from a vow, that it can never be bought back (m2). "L'interdit", the traditional term, now reads as "forbidden". Verse 29 says "voué à la destruction", as Exodus 22.

decisions.choice: "kilichowekwa wakfu kabisa" for the devoted thing (here and verse 28)
decisions.reason: "Kutakasa" already renders the verb "consecrate" in this chapter (verses 14-22), as in Leviticus 8, so the devoted thing is "set aside wholly" ("wakfu kabisa"), given for good and never bought back (m2). Verse 29 says "kuwekwa wakfu kwa maangamizi", as Exodus 22.

decisions.choice: "온전히 바친" (Literal, Balanced), "영원히 바친" (Readable) for the devoted thing (*ḥerem*)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is something given over to the LORD wholly and for good; "온전히 바친 것" is kept through verses 21 and 28-29. The English deity_pronoun span has no Korean counterpart; Balanced repeats the name instead.

source.text: וְאִם֙ אֶת־שְׂדֵ֣ה מִקְנָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֕ר לֹ֖א מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ יַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if a field of his purchase, which [is] not of [the] field of his possession, he consecrates to Yahweh,

en.L: And if he consecrates to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a field that he bought, which [is] not of the field of his possession,
en.B: If someone consecrates to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a field they have bought, which is not part of their family's land,
en.R: Someone may give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a field they bought, which is not part of their family's land.

es.L: Y si consagra {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un campo que compró, que no [es] del campo de su posesión,
es.B: Si alguien consagra {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un campo que ha comprado, que no forma parte de la tierra de su familia,
es.R: Alguien puede darle {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un campo que compró y que no es parte de la tierra de su familia.

fr.L: Et s’il consacre {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un champ qu’il a acheté, qui n’[est] pas du champ de sa possession,
fr.B: Si quelqu’un consacre {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un champ qu’il a acheté, qui ne fait pas partie de la terre de sa famille,
fr.R: Quelqu’un peut donner {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un champ qu’il a acheté et qui ne fait pas partie de la terre de sa famille.

sw.L: Na ikiwa atamtakasia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} shamba alilolinunua, ambalo si la shamba la milki yake,
sw.B: Mtu akimtakasia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} shamba alilonunua, ambalo si sehemu ya ardhi ya urithi wa jamaa yake,
sw.R: Mtu anaweza kumpa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} shamba alilonunua, ambalo si sehemu ya ardhi ya jamaa yake.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 그가 자기 소유지의 밭이 아닌, 자기가 산 밭을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩하게 구별하여 바치면,
ko.B: 누가 집안 대대로 내려온 땅이 아니라 자기가 산 밭을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩하게 구별하여 바치면,
ko.R: 누가 집안의 땅이 아니라 자기가 산 밭을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바칠 수도 있다.

decisions.choice: a bought field: land held only until the Jubilee
decisions.reason: A field bought from another family was held only until the Jubilee, when it went back to its owner (25:13-16, 28). The buyer owned only its use for the years remaining, and that is all he could give.

source.text: וְחִשַּׁב־ל֣וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מִכְסַ֣ת הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ֔ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנָתַ֤ן אֶת־הָעֶרְכְּךָ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and will calculate for him the priest the amount of your valuation until [the] year of the Jubilee, and he will give your valuation on that day, a holy thing to Yahweh.

en.L: then the priest shall calculate for him the amount of your valuation up to the year of the Jubilee, and he shall give your valuation on that day, [as] holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: the priest will work out the amount of the valuation up to the Year of Jubilee, and that person must pay the valuation on the same day as a holy gift to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The priest will figure out its price, up to the Year of Jubilee. The person must pay that price on the same day. The money is a holy gift to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: entonces el sacerdote le calculará el monto de tu valoración hasta el año del Jubileo, y él dará tu valoración en aquel día, [como cosa] santa {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: el sacerdote calculará el monto de la valoración hasta el año del Jubileo, y esa persona pagará la valoración el mismo día como un don santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: El sacerdote calculará su precio hasta el año del Jubileo. La persona tiene que pagar ese precio el mismo día. El dinero es un regalo santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: alors le prêtre calculera pour lui le montant de ton estimation jusqu’à l’année du Jubilé, et il donnera ton estimation ce jour-là, [comme chose] sainte {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: le prêtre calculera le montant de l’estimation jusqu’à l’année du Jubilé, et cette personne devra payer l’estimation le jour même, comme un don saint {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le prêtre calculera son prix jusqu’à l’année du Jubilé. La personne doit payer ce prix le jour même. L’argent est un don saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: ndipo kuhani atamhesabia kiasi cha makadirio yako hadi mwaka wa Yubile, naye atatoa makadirio yako siku hiyo, [kuwa] kitu kitakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: kuhani atahesabu kiasi cha thamani hadi mwaka wa Yubile, na mtu huyo atalipa thamani hiyo siku ileile kuwa zawadi takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kuhani atahesabu bei yake hadi mwaka wa Yubile. Mtu huyo lazima alipe bei hiyo siku ileile. Fedha hizo ni zawadi takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 제사장은 희년까지 네가 매기는 값의 액수를 그를 위하여 계산하고, 그는 그날에 네가 매기는 값을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것으로 내야 한다.
ko.B: 제사장은 희년까지 계산하여 값을 매기고, 그 사람은 바로 그날 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 예물로 그 값을 내야 한다.
ko.R: 그러면 제사장은 희년까지의 값을 계산할 것이다. 그 사람은 바로 그날 그 값을 내야 한다. 그 돈은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드리는 거룩한 예물이다.

decisions.choice: he will give on that day: the giver pays the value at once
decisions.reason: With a bought field the sanctuary does not hold the land; the one who gave it pays its value, worked out for the years to the Jubilee, on the day of the gift. The payment itself is holy to the LORD.

source.text: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת הַיּוֹבֵל֙ יָשׁ֣וּב הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנָ֖הוּ מֵאִתּ֑וֹ לַאֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] year of the Jubilee will return the field to whom he bought it from with him, to whom [belongs] the possession of the land.

en.L: In the year of the Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom he bought it, to the one to whom the possession of the land [belongs].
en.B: In the Year of Jubilee the field will go back to the one from whom it was bought, the one whose family land it is.
en.R: In the Year of Jubilee the field will go back to the person who sold it, whose family the land belongs to.

es.L: En el año del Jubileo el campo volverá a aquel de quien lo compró, a aquel a quien [pertenece] la posesión de la tierra.
es.B: En el año del Jubileo el campo volverá a aquel a quien se le compró, a quien pertenece como tierra de su familia.
es.R: En el año del Jubileo el campo volverá a la persona que lo vendió, a la familia a la que pertenece la tierra.

fr.L: À l’année du Jubilé, le champ retournera à celui de qui il l’avait acheté, à celui à qui [appartient] la possession de la terre.
fr.B: À l’année du Jubilé, le champ reviendra à celui à qui il a été acheté, celui dont c’est la terre de famille.
fr.R: Pendant l’année du Jubilé, le champ reviendra à la personne qui l’a vendu, à la famille à qui la terre appartient.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa Yubile shamba litamrudia yule aliyelinunua kutoka kwake, yule ambaye milki ya ardhi [ni] yake.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa Yubile shamba litarudi kwa yule aliyeliuza, ambaye ardhi hiyo ni urithi wa jamaa yake.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa Yubile shamba litarudi kwa mtu aliyeliuza, kwa jamaa ambayo ardhi hiyo ni mali yake.

ko.L: 희년에 그 밭은 그가 그것을 산 사람, 곧 그 땅을 소유한 사람에게로 돌아갈 것이다.
ko.B: 희년이 되면 그 밭은 그것을 판 사람, 곧 그 땅을 집안 대대로 소유해 온 사람에게 돌아간다.
ko.R: 희년이 되면 그 밭은 그 밭을 판 사람에게 돌아간다. 그 땅은 원래 그 사람 집안의 것이다.

decisions.choice: the field returns to its owner: the Jubilee law holds
decisions.reason: The rule of 25:10, 13, 28 applies even to a field given to the sanctuary: it goes back to the family that holds it as its possession. Family land could not pass out of a family for good by sale (25:23).

source.text: וְכָל־עֶרְכְּךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And every your valuation will be by [the] shekel of the holy place; twenty gerah[s] will be the shekel.

en.L: And every valuation of yours shall be by the shekel of the sanctuary; twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
en.B: Every valuation is to be by the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.
en.R: Every price must be figured by the official shekel used at the holy tent. That shekel weighs twenty gerahs.

ko.L: 그리고 네가 매기는 모든 값은 성소의 세겔로 해야 한다. 이십 게라가 한 세겔이다.
ko.B: 모든 값은 성소의 세겔로 매겨야 한다. 한 세겔은 이십 게라이다.
ko.R: 모든 값은 성막에서 쓰는 공식 세겔로 계산해야 한다. 그 세겔 하나의 무게는 이십 게라이다.

decisions.choice: twenty gerahs: the sanctuary shekel defined
decisions.reason: The gerah was the smallest unit of weight, about half a gram, a twentieth of a shekel. The same definition is given in Exodus 30:13, Numbers 3:47 and Ezekiel 45:12. On the shekel, see verse 3.

source.text: אַךְ־בְּכ֞וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יְבֻכַּ֤ר לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא־יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֹת֑וֹ אִם־שׁ֣וֹר אִם־שֶׂ֔ה לַֽיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Nevertheless a firstborn which is born first to Yahweh among livestock, not a man will consecrate it; whether an ox or a sheep, to Yahweh it [belongs].

en.L: Nevertheless a firstborn among livestock, which is born first to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} — {{gender:a person|a man}} shall not consecrate it; whether ox or sheep, it [belongs] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But {{gender:no one|no man}} may consecrate the firstborn of an animal, since a firstborn already belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Whether it is from the cattle or the flock, it is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s.
en.R: But no one may promise to give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the first animal born to a cow or a sheep. It already belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

ko.L: 그러나 짐승 가운데 처음 난 것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 처음 난 것이므로, 아무도 그것을 거룩하게 구별하여 바치지 못한다. 소든 양이든 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 짐승의 처음 난 것은 이미 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이므로, 아무도 그것을 따로 구별하여 바칠 수 없다. 소든 양이든 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 소나 양의 첫 새끼는 아무도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바치겠다고 약속할 수 없다. 그것은 이미 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: a firstborn belongs to the LORD already
decisions.reason: Every firstborn male of the herd and flock belonged to the LORD from birth (Exodus 13:2, 12; 34:19; Numbers 18:17). It could not be offered by vow, because one cannot give what is already his.

decisions.choice: ox or sheep: cattle or the flock
decisions.reason: The first word is a head of cattle; the second is one animal of the flock, sheep or goat.

decisions.choice: since / already
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that "which is born first to the LORD" gives the reason it cannot be consecrated.

decisions.choice: "처음 난 것" (Literal, Balanced), "첫 새끼" (Readable) for the firstborn of animals
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words for the firstborn of animals; "맏아들" stays for a firstborn son.

source.text: וְאִ֨ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּמֵאָה֙ וּפָדָ֣ה בְעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְאִם־לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְנִמְכַּ֥ר בְּעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And if among the unclean livestock, and he will ransom [it] by your valuation and he will add its fifth to it; and if not it is redeemed, and it will be sold by your valuation.

en.L: And if [it is] among the unclean livestock, then he shall ransom [it] by your valuation and add its fifth to it; and if it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold by your valuation.
en.B: If it is an unclean animal, the owner may buy it back at its valuation, adding a fifth to it. If it is not redeemed, it is to be sold at its valuation.
en.R: If the first animal born is unclean, the owner may buy it back. They must pay the set price plus one fifth more. If they do not buy it back, it must be sold at the set price.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 [그것이] 부정한 짐승 가운데 [하나]이면, 그는 네가 매기는 값으로 [그것을] 되찾고, 그것에 그 오분의 일을 더해야 한다. 만일 그것이 물러지지 않으면, 네가 매기는 값으로 팔아야 한다.
ko.B: 부정한 짐승의 처음 난 것이면, 주인은 매긴 값에 오분의 일을 더 얹어서 내고 그것을 되찾을 수 있다. 그것을 무르지 않으면, 매긴 값으로 팔아야 한다.
ko.R: 처음 난 새끼가 부정한 짐승이면, 주인은 그것을 다시 살 수 있다. 정해진 값에 오분의 일을 더 내야 한다. 다시 사지 않으면, 그 새끼는 정해진 값에 팔아야 한다.

decisions.choice: among the unclean livestock: an unclean firstborn
decisions.reason: Following verse 26, this most likely means the firstborn of an unclean animal. Exodus 13:13 and 34:20 have the firstborn donkey redeemed with a lamb or else its neck broken; here a payment of silver is allowed, or the animal is sold and the price goes to the sanctuary. The verse may instead be a general rule for unclean animals.

decisions.choice: ransom ... redeem: two words for buying back
decisions.reason: The first verb means to ransom or set free by payment; the second is the word used for redeeming in verses 13-20. Here they mean the same.

decisions.choice: the first animal born
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject, following m1.

decisions.choice: "되찾다" for ransom (*padah*) and "무르다" for redeem (*gaʾal*)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes two Hebrew words for buying back; Korean keeps two verbs at Literal and Balanced, and Readable uses "다시 사다" for both.

source.text: אַךְ־כָּל־חֵ֡רֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַחֲרִם֩ אִ֨ישׁ לַֽיהוָ֜ה מִכָּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֗וֹ מֵאָדָ֤ם וּבְהֵמָה֙ וּמִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כָּל־חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ־קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Nevertheless every devoted thing which a man devotes to Yahweh, from all that [is] his, from humankind and livestock and from [the] field of his possession, not it will be sold and not it will be redeemed; every devoted thing [is] most holy to Yahweh.

en.L: Nevertheless, every devoted thing that {{gender:a person|a man}} devotes to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from all that he has, of human and of animal and of the field of his possession, shall not be sold and shall not be redeemed; every devoted thing [is] a most holy [thing] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But anything that {{gender:anyone|any man}} devotes to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from what they own, whether human or animal or a field they hold as family land, may not be sold and may not be bought back. All that is devoted is most holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But someone may give something to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as fully devoted to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. It may be a person, an animal, or family land. It can never be sold or bought back. Everything devoted in this way is very holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

ko.L: 그러나 누가 자기 소유 가운데서, 사람이든 짐승이든 자기 소유지의 밭이든, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 온전히 바친 것은 모두 팔지도 못하고 무르지도 못한다. 온전히 바친 것은 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 지극히 거룩한 [것]이다.
ko.B: 그러나 누구든지 자기 소유 가운데서 사람이든 짐승이든 집안 대대로 내려온 밭이든 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 온전히 바친 것은 팔 수도 없고 무를 수도 없다. 온전히 바친 것은 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 지극히 거룩한 것이다.
ko.R: 누가 자기의 것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 영원히 바칠 수도 있다. 그것은 사람일 수도 있고, 짐승이나 집안의 땅일 수도 있다. 그렇게 바친 것은 절대로 팔거나 다시 살 수 없다. 그렇게 바친 것은 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 아주 거룩한 것이다.

decisions.choice: devoted thing: given over to the LORD wholly and for good
decisions.reason: The noun and its verb describe something taken out of human use and handed over to the LORD with no way back. Unlike a vow (verses 2-27), it cannot be redeemed. A devoted thing belonged to the sanctuary and the priests (verse 21; Numbers 18:14; Ezekiel 44:29). In war the same word is used for the enemy and their goods given over to the LORD by destruction (Numbers 21:2-3; Deuteronomy 7:2; Joshua 6:17-21; 1 Samuel 15:3).

decisions.choice: of human: persons under the owner's control
decisions.reason: The verse lists what an owner might devote: people, animals and land. The people are most likely those in his household under his authority, such as slaves; the verse does not say what became of them, and verse 29 deals with a different case.

decisions.choice: most holy: of the highest holiness
decisions.reason: "Holy of holies" is the strongest form of "holy", used of the most sacred offerings (2:3). A devoted thing belongs to the LORD in the fullest way.

decisions.choice: fully devoted to him
decisions.reason: Readable explains "devote" as giving something to the LORD fully, in line with m1.

source.text: כָּל־חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יָחֳרַ֛ם מִן־הָאָדָ֖ם לֹ֣א יִפָּדֶ֑ה מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: Every devoted person who is devoted from humankind not will be ransomed; surely he will be put to death.

en.L: Every devoted [person] who is devoted from humankind shall not be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
en.B: When a human being has been placed under the ban for destruction, no ransom may be paid for them; they must be put to death.
en.R: If a person has been devoted to destruction, no one can pay to set that person free. That person must be put to death.

ko.L: 사람 가운데서 온전히 바쳐진 [사람은] 누구도 되찾을 수 없다. 그는 반드시 죽임을 당해야 한다.
ko.B: 사람이 멸망에 바쳐졌으면, 아무도 값을 치르고 그를 되찾을 수 없다. 그는 반드시 죽임을 당해야 한다.
ko.R: 멸망당하도록 바쳐진 사람은 아무도 값을 치르고 풀어 줄 수 없다. 그 사람은 사형에 처해야 한다.

decisions.choice: devoted from humankind: a person placed under the ban by judgment
decisions.reason: The verb is passive: the person "is devoted", not by a private vow (verses 2-8, where a person could always be redeemed) but most likely by a judgment under God's law. The law says that whoever sacrifices to other gods is to be devoted to destruction (Exodus 22:19), and a whole town that turns to other gods is to be devoted in the same way (Deuteronomy 13). The word is also used for enemies devoted in war (Numbers 21:2-3; Joshua 6:17; 1 Samuel 15:3). The verse does not say who carried out the death, nor does it allow an owner to put someone to death by a vow. What exactly it covers is not certain.

decisions.choice: not ransomed ... surely put to death
decisions.reason: "Ransomed" is the verb of verse 27. A devoted person cannot be bought free as a vowed person can. "Surely put to death" is the form used for the death penalty elsewhere in the law (20:2, 9-16).

decisions.choice: placed under the ban for destruction
decisions.reason: Balanced spells out that this is the ban (m1), and that the passive verb describes a person put in that state, not an offering.

decisions.choice: no one can pay to set that person free
decisions.reason: Readable explains "ransomed".

decisions.choice: "멸망에 바쳐지다" for a person placed under the ban
decisions.reason: The meaning decision's footnote explains the ban; Balanced and Readable say plainly that the person is given over to destruction, as the English does, while Literal keeps "온전히 바쳐진" from verse 28.

source.text: וְכָל־מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָאָ֜רֶץ מִזֶּ֤רַע הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ לַיהוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] tithe of the land, of [the] seed of the land, of [the] fruit of the tree, to Yahweh it [belongs]; a holy thing to Yahweh.

en.L: And every tithe of the land, of the seed of the land [and] of the fruit of the tree, it [belongs] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; [it is] holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: All the tithe of the land belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, both grain from what is sown and fruit from the trees. It is holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: A tenth of everything the land produces belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. This includes grain from the fields and fruit from the trees. It is holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

ko.L: 그리고 땅의 모든 십분의 일, 곧 땅의 씨앗과 나무의 열매[의 십분의 일]은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이다. [그것은] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것이다.
ko.B: 땅에서 난 것의 십분의 일은 곡식이든 나무 열매든 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이다. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것이다.
ko.R: 땅에서 나는 모든 것의 십분의 일은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이다. 밭에서 거둔 곡식과 나무에서 딴 열매도 그렇다. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것이다.

decisions.choice: tithe: a tenth part
decisions.reason: The word means a tenth. Abram gave a tenth to Melchizedek (Genesis 14:20) and Jacob promised a tenth to God (Genesis 28:22). The law gives the tithe to the Levites for their service (Numbers 18:21-24) and also tells how it was to be eaten in a festival (Deuteronomy 14:22-29). Like the firstborn, it already belongs to the LORD and is not a vow.

decisions.choice: the seed of the land, the fruit of the tree: grain and fruit
decisions.reason: "Seed" here is what grows from sowing, the grain of the fields; "fruit of the tree" covers the produce of trees and vines, such as olives and grapes (Deuteronomy 14:23).

decisions.choice: a tenth
decisions.reason: Readable says what "tithe" means; Literal and Balanced keep the word.

decisions.choice: "십분의 일" for the tithe at every level
decisions.reason: As the Genesis sheet sets; "십일조" is the church word for a church offering today, while "십분의 일" says what the law requires.

source.text: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל אִ֖ישׁ מִמַּֽעַשְׂר֑וֹ חֲמִשִׁית֖וֹ יֹסֵ֥ף עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And if indeed he redeems, a man, some of his tithe, its fifth he will add to it.

en.L: And if {{gender:a person|a man}} does indeed redeem some of his tithe, he shall add its fifth to it.
en.B: If {{gender:anyone|any man}} wants to redeem any of their tithe, they must add a fifth to its value.
en.R: If someone wants to buy back part of their tenth, they must pay its value plus one fifth more.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 누가 정말로 자기의 십분의 일 가운데 얼마를 무르려면, 그것에 그 오분의 일을 더해야 한다.
ko.B: 누구든지 자기가 바칠 십분의 일 가운데 얼마를 무르려면, 그 값에 오분의 일을 더 얹어서 내야 한다.
ko.R: 누가 자기의 십분의 일 가운데 얼마를 다시 사고 싶으면, 그 값에 오분의 일을 더 내야 한다.

decisions.choice: redeem some of his tithe: keep the produce and pay its value plus a fifth
decisions.reason: An owner could keep part of his grain or fruit tithe by paying its value and a fifth more, as with vowed gifts (verses 13, 15, 19). Animals of the tithe could not be redeemed (verse 33).

source.text: וְכָל־מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] tithe of [the] herd and [the] flock, all that passes under the rod, the tenth will be holy to Yahweh.

en.L: And every tithe of herd and flock, all that passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: As for the herd and the flock, of all the animals that pass under the rod as they are counted, every tenth one will be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The shepherd counts the cattle, sheep and goats as they walk under his staff. Every tenth animal will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as holy.

ko.L: 그리고 소 떼와 양 떼의 모든 십분의 일, 곧 막대기 아래로 지나가는 모든 것 가운데 열째 것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩할 것이다.
ko.B: 소 떼와 양 떼는 목자가 막대기 아래로 지나가게 하며 셀 때에 열 마리째마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것이 된다.
ko.R: 목자는 소와 양과 염소가 자기 지팡이 아래로 지나갈 때 그 수를 센다. 그 가운데 열 번째 짐승은 모두 거룩한 것으로서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이 된다.

decisions.choice: passes under the rod: is counted by the shepherd
decisions.reason: A shepherd counted his animals as they went one by one beneath his rod or staff (Jeremiah 33:13; Ezekiel 20:37). Every tenth animal that passed was the LORD's, whatever it was like, so the choice was left to the count and not to the owner (verse 33).

decisions.choice: herd and flock: cattle, and sheep and goats
decisions.reason: The herd is cattle; the flock is sheep and goats together, as in 1:2.

decisions.choice: as they are counted / The shepherd counts
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what passing under the rod is for (m1).

source.text: לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר בֵּֽין־ט֥וֹב לָרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑נּוּ וְאִם־הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔נּוּ וְהָֽיָה־ה֧וּא וּתְמוּרָת֛וֹ יִֽהְיֶה־קֹ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Not he will inspect between good and bad and not he will exchange it; and if indeed he exchanges it, and will be it and its substitute holy; not it will be redeemed.

en.L: He shall not inspect [whether it is] good or bad, and he shall not exchange it; and if he does indeed exchange it, then it and its substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.'"
en.B: The owner is not to look over the animals to sort good from poor, and must not exchange one for another. If they do make an exchange, the animal and the one put in its place will both be holy, and neither can be redeemed.'"
en.R: The owner must not look to see if the animal is good or bad, and must not trade it for another. If they do trade, both animals will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as holy. Neither one can be bought back.'"

ko.L: 그는 좋은지 나쁜지 살피지 말고, 그것을 맞바꾸지도 말라. 만일 그가 정말로 그것을 맞바꾸면, 그것과 그 대신한 것이 둘 다 거룩할 것이니, 그것은 물러지지 않을 것이다.'"
ko.B: 주인은 좋은 것과 나쁜 것을 골라내지 말고, 다른 것으로 바꾸지도 말라. 만일 바꾸면, 처음 짐승과 그 대신 바친 짐승이 둘 다 거룩하게 되어 어느 것도 무를 수 없다.'"
ko.R: 주인은 그 짐승이 좋은지 나쁜지 살펴보면 안 되고, 다른 짐승과 바꾸어도 안 된다. 만일 바꾸면, 두 짐승이 모두 거룩한 것으로서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이 된다. 어느 것도 다시 살 수 없다.'"

decisions.choice: inspect: look over in order to choose
decisions.reason: The verb means to examine or seek out, as a shepherd looks over his flock (Ezekiel 34:11-12). The owner is not to pick which animals pass tenth, good or poor.

decisions.choice: exchange ... it and its substitute: the rule of verse 10
decisions.reason: The penalty for swapping is the same as for a vowed animal (verse 10): both become holy. And a tithe animal cannot be redeemed, unlike the grain tithe (verse 31).

decisions.choice: will belong to the LORD as holy
decisions.reason: Readable explains "holy" here as belonging to the LORD, as in verse 10.

en.L: These [are] the commandments that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded Moses for the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel on Mount Sinai.
en.B: These are the commandments {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} laid on Moses for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, on Mount Sinai.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave all these commands to Moses on Mount Sinai, for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

ko.L: 이것들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내 산에서 이스라엘 자손을 위하여 모세에게 명령하신 계명들이다.
ko.B: 이것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내 산에서 이스라엘 백성을 위하여 모세에게 내리신 계명이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시내 산에서 이스라엘 사람들을 위하여 이 모든 계명을 모세에게 주셨다.

decisions.choice: these are the commandments: the close of the book
decisions.reason: The verse ends this chapter and Leviticus as a whole, as 26:46 closed the laws before it. "On Mount Sinai" places all of it at the mountain, as 7:38 and 25:1 do, before Israel sets out in Numbers.

decisions.choice: commandments: the instructions God gave
decisions.reason: The word is the general term for what God commands, from the same root as the verb "commanded" in this verse (4:2; 26:3).
